4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.

7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That Consent Calendar Items 7 a-l be approved.

DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION TO ADOPT PROPOSED ORDINANCES ADOPTING BY REFERENCE THE 2020 LOS ANGELES COUNTY BUILDING CODES
Presented by Alicia Velasco, Community and Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council after the City Attorney reads the title:
(1) Adopt an urgency ordinance of the City of Lomita adopting by reference the 2020 Los Angeles County Building, Electrical, Plumbing, Mechanical, Residential, Existing Building, and Green Building Codes with certain amendments necessitated by local conditions, and declaring the urgency thereof; and
(2) After the City Attorney reads the title of the ordinance, introduce on first reading an ordinance adopting by reference the 2020 Los Angeles County Building, Electrical, Plumbing, Mechanical, Residential, Existing Building, and Green Building Codes with certain amendments necessitated by local conditions; and
(3) Direct staff to schedule a public hearing for the second reading and adoption of the ordinance for the January 21, 2020, City Council meeting. This procedure is in accordance with California Government Code, Title 5, Division 1, Part 1, as required by the Building Standards Commission. CONSIDERATION AND POSSIBLE DIRECTION ON A 45 DAY MORATORIUM ON NEW VAPE/E-CIGARETTE SHOPS WITHIN THE CITY
Presented by Alicia Velasco, Community & Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council approve an urgency ordinance adopting a 45-day moratorium prohibiting any new vape/e-cigarette shops from opening within the City.

ADJOURNMENT Due to the holiday schedule, the January 7, 2020, City Council meeting has been cancelled. The next regular meeting will be held on Tuesday, January 21, 2020, at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
